summary.key_theme: 受惠於 AI 基礎設施需求強勁，Aries 與 Taurus 產品線營收成長顯著，且市場對其納入 S&P 指數預期心理濃厚，帶動股價近期反彈。

bullish.title: ALAB Gains From Aries and Taurus Strength: Can It Beat MRVL & CRDO?

bullish.title: Nvidia Barely Moved. These 2 AI Connectivity Stocks Jumped More Than 7%

bullish.title: Bloom Energy, Astera Rally On Hopes They Will Join S&P Friday
bullish.reason: 市場預期 ALAB 有望被納入 S&P 指數，此類指數成分股調整通常會帶來被動式資金流入，對股價具有正面催化作用。

bullish.title: Quanex Building Products, Concrete Pumping, SanDisk And Other Big Stocks Moving Higher On Friday
bullish.reason: 報導指出 ALAB 在當日市場普遍下跌的環境下逆勢走高，反映出個股強勁的買盤動能。

bearish.title: ALAB Stock Down 24% in a Month: Should Investors Buy the Dip or Wait?
bearish.reason: 一個月內股價下跌 24 %，顯示短期內籌碼面較為凌亂，投資人對高估值 AI 股的波動性感到擔憂。

bearish.title: Why Is Astera Labs, Inc. (ALAB) Down 13.9% Since Last Earnings Report?
bearish.reason: 儘管公司成長強勁，但財報後股價下跌 13.9 %，顯示市場對其財測或估值溢價存在修正壓力。

neutral.title: Astera Labs, Inc. (ALAB) Presents at Citi's 2026 Global TMT Conference Transcript

neutral.title: Better Artificial Intelligence Stock: Astera Labs vs. NVIDIA
